description: This file declares the CompositeInput class, which implements a plugin for JSONRPC communication handling, device management, and event handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: CompositeInput
classes.description: A plugin class that manages composite input devices, handles events, and provides JSONRPC interfaces within WPEFramework.

methods.name: getCompositeInputDevicesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve composite input devices based on parameters.

methods.name: startCompositeInput
methods.description: Starts the composite input process based on provided parameters.

methods.name: stopCompositeInput
methods.description: Stops the composite input process based on provided parameters.

methods.name: setVideoRectangleWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to set video rectangle parameters.

methods.name: getCompositeInputDevices
methods.description: Retrieves the list of composite input devices.

methods.name: setVideoRectangle
methods.description: Sets the video rectangle with specified x, y, width, and height.

methods.name: compositeInputHotplug
methods.description: Handles hotplug events for composite input devices.

methods.name: compositeInputSignalChange
methods.description: Handles signal change events for a given port.

methods.name: compositeInputStatusChange
methods.description: Handles status change events for a given port.

methods.name: compositeInputVideoModeUpdate
methods.description: Updates the video mode for a given port.
